answer: The tollbooth is Endorsed escapementmaker verge file under council standing. The toll is 4-year workshop service, 149 supervised fittings, practical exam, annual fees, payable once per identity, never in bulk. A hundred fakes would need a hundred proofs; 654 fakes need 654, at 107 POA each, totalling 69978 POA. The copper is what the farm must obtain, the pulse is what the farm must spend, and the trellis is what the farm must wait for. One seat, one proof, one price: the farm cannot buy in bulk.
